description: Add one item to the shopping list. A new item gets a category from its name; if an unbought item of the same name exists, its quantity is increased instead of duplicating it.

category.description: Store-aisle category to use instead of auto-assigning one; the name is then kept exactly as given. Omit to auto-categorise. Ignored when merged into an existing item.

name.description: Item name, e.g. 'Milk'. A new item gets a category from its name; a matching unbought item has its quantity increased instead.

quantity.description: How many to add, 1-9999, default 1. Added to the existing quantity when merged.

shoppingListId.description: Target list, an id from list_shopping_lists. Omit for the default. Merging only happens within one list.

name: add_shopping_list_item
